INSERT INTO factory_team_settings (team_id, standing_rules, queue_limit, token_budget)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (team_id)
            DO UPDATE SET
                standing_rules = EXCLUDED.standing_rules,
                queue_limit = EXCLUDED.queue_limit,
                token_budget = EXCLUDED.token_budget,
                updated_at = now()
